test_title: PYST 7: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Based on function, which of the following combinations represent all types of animal tissues found in humans?

options.text: Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue and Reproductive tissue
Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue, Muscular tissue and Nervous tissue
Epithelial tissue, Muscular tissue and Glandular tissue
Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue and Skeletal tissue

solution:
The correct answer is __**Epithelial tissue, Connective tissue, Muscular tissue, and Nervous tissue**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Animal tissues** are classified into four main types based on their function and structure: **Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, and Nervous tissues**. These are the fundamental tissues found in all animals, including humans.
 
• **Epithelial tissue**: This tissue forms the covering or lining of internal and external body surfaces. It is involved in **protection, absorption, secretion, and sensory reception**. Example: Skin epithelium, lining of the digestive tract.
 
• **Connective tissue**: It provides support, binds different body parts, and plays a role in the transportation of nutrients and waste. Examples include **blood, bones, cartilage, ligaments, and adipose tissue**.
 
• **Muscular tissue**: This tissue is responsible for body movement. It consists of three types: **skeletal muscle (voluntary movement), smooth muscle (involuntary movement), and cardiac muscle (heart contractions)**.
